product-analyst.description: Reverse-engineer product identity, personas, value proposition, and capability map from knowledge/, features/, business/, and product-architecture/ inputs. Discover only — do not redesign or implement.

workflow-analyzer.description: Discover end-to-end user and system workflows from product-model plus product-architecture/ and features/. Map steps, actors, and handoffs without inventing new product behavior.

requirement-generator.description: Extract structured product requirements (SHALL/MUST) from discovered product and workflow knowledge plus business rules. Traceable only; no redesign. role_alias=requirement-extractor.

acceptance-criteria-generator.description: Extract testable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then) for each discovered requirement. Observable and falsifiable; no invention. role_alias=acceptance-criteria-extractor.

product-knowledge-ingest.description: Populate knowledge/ notes from docs and soft discovery-report inputs. Discover only — do not redesign.

feature-surface-inventory.description: Inventory product feature surfaces from routes/UI/domain actions into features/. Discover only — do not redesign.

business-rules-extractor.description: Extract observed business rules from DOMAIN_MODEL and domain engines into business/. Discover only — do not invent rules.

product-architecture-observer.description: Observe product architecture into product-architecture/ (never ai-os/architecture/). Discover only — do not redesign.

product-re-gap-report.description: Synthesize coverage gaps across Product RE ingest and transform outputs. Discover only — do not redesign.
